newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse to introduce stricter listing rule.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse to introduce stricter listing rule.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand said on Thursday its board had approved stricter listing rules to improve the quality of shares traded on the exchange.

Under the new rules, a company seeking to list on the exchange must have a market capitalisation of at least three billion baht ($115.38 million) compared with the existing requirement of 750 million baht, exchange spokesman Suvicha Mingkwan said.
The company must also have a good track record with profits of between 110 million and 150 million baht compared with 80-110 million now, he said.
The proposed new rules require final approval from the Securities and Exchange Commission before being implemented, he added.
